video_title: Kaepernick Reveals What the NFL Wanted Him to Sign

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Colin Kaepernick on NFL owners blocking his return to the league
quotes.excerpt: We know it's been the owners that have been keeping me out.

text_blocks.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
text_blocks.text: I want one of them to open the door. One of the NFL owners. We know it's been the owners that have been keeping me out. We've had coaches say I'm a starter. We've had multiple coaches, multiple GMs that want to bring me in, and that's been stopped.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: Talk to us about that. That's another side of the mental that I wanted to tap into because, again, you quarterback my squad.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kaepernick on the NFL's surprise workout invitation in 2019
quotes.excerpt: I just got the weirdest call from the NFL league office. They said you have a workout.

text_blocks.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
text_blocks.text: I get a call from my agent. I'm training with my trainer. He's like, 'Hey, I just got the weirdest call from the NFL league office. They said you have a workout on Saturday.' They need to know by 2:00 p.m. yes or no. This is out of the blue. We've not been in communication with the league office at this point. There was no indication to us that this was coming.

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: This is out of the blue. Walk us back because I remember when it came, but I don't remember how many years ago, but the tryout where it was supposed to be at one place, ended up being somewhere else.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kaepernick on the NFL's restrictive waiver for his 2019 workout
quotes.excerpt: The waiver the NFL wanted me to sign waived all of my employment rights.

text_blocks.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
text_blocks.text: The waiver the NFL wanted me to sign waived all of my employment rights. They had an outside law firm draft a waiver specifically for me. Whether it was collusion, discrimination, anything within my employment rights, holistically, were out the window if I signed that waiver. My lawyers were like, 'It's malpractice if we tell you to sign this.'

text_blocks.speaker: Matt Barnes
text_blocks.text: The waiver that the NFL wanted me to sign waived all of my employment rights.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Eric Reid's role in Kaepernick's decision to take a knee
quotes.excerpt: Eric Reid, who was our first-round pick as a safety out of LSU, he was like, 'Look, I see what you're doing.'

text_blocks.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
text_blocks.text: During that fourth preseason game, or prior to it, I sat down with Eric Reid. Eric Reid from Baton Rouge, he was our first-round pick as a safety out of LSU. He was like, 'Look, I see what you're doing and what you're trying to accomplish. I believe in it and I want to be a part of it. Would you be open to, if we take a knee and allows us to address a number of issues that people have brought up as far as being part of the protest?' I was like, 'Yeah, I'm good with that.'

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kaepernick on the NFL and political pushback to his protest
quotes.excerpt: There were 32 owners, 32 billionaires of the NFL that were working together against this.
quotes.quote: There were 32 owners, 32 billionaires of the NFL that were working together against this. There was the NFL as a league working against this, and also working with the President of the United States. It wasn't a small opponent in this, but I think that realization also just made us that much more focused and dedicated to make sure that we were staying true to the purpose and the mission and being clear about that.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kaepernick on corporations using social justice for marketing
quotes.excerpt: People were coming to us and asking questions, not because they genuinely wanted to get insight.
quotes.quote: People were coming to us and asking questions, not because they genuinely wanted to get insight or genuinely wanted to address the issue. It was just like, 'Hey, this is going to make me look good or I'm going to get a lot of hits on this. This is great, tell us more.' And navigating that and trying to redirect those efforts back to the focus of police brutality and back to the work that's being done directly in communities.

quotes.speaker: Colin Kaepernick
quotes.summary_phrase: Kaepernick on Nike's steadfast support of his social justice work
quotes.excerpt: Nike has been incredible to me. At this point, we've been together for 15 years.
quotes.quote: Nike has been incredible to me. At this point, we've been together for 15 years. During that 2016-2017 moment, it was actually some navigating of the internal of Nike. Shout out to Gino, who was leading, I believe it was Brand for North America. He was like, 'Look, I want to have a better understanding of what you're trying to accomplish, and we're going to help bring that to life.' They've supported our work directly in communities. They've supported our work across a number of different things that we've been trying to accomplish.
